definitions.full: H6554. Parpar מַּרְמַּר proper name, of a river near Damascus 2Kin 5:12 (A) φαρφαρ ; A φαρφαρα ; perhaps modern 'Awaj , south of Damascus Rob BR iii. 447 f .
